name: Beast Heart
source:
Play as Rice, who is trying to save their partner, who died a hundred years ago, in a fantasy world, and figure out all this as part of a therapy.

[Edited from [url=https://nick-lothario.itch.io/beast-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演赖斯，在一个奇幻世界里设法拯救百年前就已逝去的伴侣，并在治疗过程中尝试理清这一切。
